name: On-chain Forensics
description: Decision-first on-chain forensics. Ask whether a token is worth touching and get a graded, measured answer instead of raw data: activity score 0-100, letter grade A-F, tier, risk flags and a reason. Answers come from a precomputed cache of measured chain reads, so the agent never invents data; unknown tokens are reported as NOT_CACHED with the exact paid call to grade them.

x402.description: Live grading of an ungraded token is paid in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) at $0.02 per call. Cached context answers are free.

skills.name: Token verdict
skills.description: Is this token alive and how risky is it? Returns grade (A-F), score 0-100, tier, risk flags and a reason, measured from transfer and distinct-wallet activity.

skills.name: Graded token directory
skills.description: Free browsable directory of graded tokens on Ethereum and Base, one page per token with grade, rank and percentile against the chain median.
examples: Which Base tokens are graded F?

skills.name: Embeddable grade badge
skills.description: Free SVG badge returning the grade for any contract. Cached, no key, degrades to NOT GRADED instead of a broken image.
examples: Give me a badge for this contract

metadata.notes: Free answers cover already-graded tokens. Nothing is fabricated for an ungraded token.
